warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.00 + 3.00 + 1.00 (7.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01 (both views), S-02, A-03, A-04/A-05 (elevations) and A-06/A-07 (sections) and all agree. Vector CAD PDF; the dimension figures are vector strokes (not in the text layer) and were read off the rendered page at zoom; grid bubbles and member marks were cross-checked against the PDF text layer.

Section 4 rule 4 (every printed x/y tick is a line): structural ticks 1''' (1.90, S-01/A-08) and A''' (1.50, S-01/A-03/A-08); roof-plan ticks 1'/3' (main-roof 1.00 overhang, x), A' (main-roof 1.00 overhang beyond row A), 2' (lean-to edge 1.00 right of grid 2) and D' (lean-to edge 1.00 beyond row D); and every 1.000 truss panel point (T2 on x: 1'', 1'''', 2', 2''; T1 on y: A'', A'''', B', B''). The lean-to edge at 4.00 and the T2 panel point at 4.00 are the same position — one line 2'.

The truss elevations on S-03 print no grid bubbles. Their chains are anchored on the supports: T2 runs on row C between grids 1-2-3 on the S-02 roof plan and its sub-totals 3.00 | 3.00 | 6.00 match those grids; T1 runs on grids 1, 2, 3 with its high end at T2 (row C, drawn left, matching รูปตัด B where row C is left and the roof is high at C) and its sub-totals 3.00 | 3.00 | 6.00 match C-B-A. Panel points are symmetric, so the drawing direction does not change any position.

Not a line: the ลานซักล้าง ground slab (GS) drawn outside row A between grids 1 and 2 on S-01 and A-03 has no printed dimension to its outer edge and no beam on it (single outline) — its edge is NOT made a dummy line (section 4: no line without a printed dimension or beam endpoint). It scales to about 1.60 beyond row A, recorded only in the slab element note.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน (A-06/A-07 and A-01 notes). Two column-top levels are printed (+3.04 and +3.46) for the mono-pitch frame. The elevations label +3.46 as ระดับหลังหัวเสา and ±0.00 as ระดับถนน; both are merged into the section labels. On the elevations the 0.46 figure of the z chain is printed just below the ±0.00 line (drafting offset) — read as the ±0.00 to +0.46 segment, which is the only place 0.46 can close the 4.36 total. Room-tag floor levels +0.10 (ลานซักล้าง) and +0.36 (ห้องน้ำ, ระเบียง) have no printed label — id null.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-05 plus A-03 (floor plan + roof plan), A-04/A-05 (elevations), A-06/A-07 (building sections) and the A-08 bathroom enlargement. Not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run: A-08 fixture-installation-height elevation (sanitary standard), A-09 door/window sizes (kept on the schedule elements), E-01 electrical and SN-01/SN-02 sanitary sheets. S-04/S-05 and S-03 print only member-internal dimensions (footing plan size and depth, section sizes, slab thickness, step riser/tread, truss depths 0.899/0.746), which stay on their elements.
